Post 1

📉 ASX 200 hit a fresh 50-day low Thursday, sliding 63.30pts or 0.72% to 8,702.00. A-REITs and Materials led the selling while buy-now-pay-later took a hammering. Year-to-date gains have been wiped to flat. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔻 A-REITs worst sector at -1.95%, Materials -1.46%, Telcos -1.08%. Energy the standout bright spot at +1.17%. Defensives held — Consumer Staples +0.35%, Utilities +0.29%. Risk-off rotation playing out in real time. #ASX #realestate #energy #ausbiz

Post 3

ZIP cratered 11.38% to AUD 1.985 — the session's ugliest print. Nine Entertainment fell 7.59% to AUD 0.670. PMV bucked the tape hard, surging 7.08% to AUD 11.95. Three very different stories in one session. #ASX #ausbiz #consumerfinance

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,139.98/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7039. Silver AUD 91.96/oz, Platinum AUD 2,501.99/oz. Metals priced richly in local terms — but Materials sector still fell 1.46%. Currency doing the heavy lifting, not demand. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5

8,702 is now the line. A 50-day low with flat YTD gains — one more down session and the narrative shifts from consolidation to breakdown. Energy held today. Does it lead a bounce, or does Materials drag everything lower? What's your read? #ASX #ausbiz #technicalanalysis
